segments.name: Financial product marketplaces
segments.description: Operates an online platform giving consumers and SMBs independent editorial content, comparison tools and marketplaces for financial products, plus mortgage brokering and investment advisory services.
segments.evidence: As a result, the Company has concluded that it has one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Financial services providers such as banks, credit card issuers, lenders, insurers and investment brokers pay fees for leads, matches and referrals to the company audience of consumers and SMBs.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue primarily through referral fees, lead generation, and partner-based monetization, as well as through revenue derived from brokering and advisory services.
